listar:
D=/home/learner/aso/f32
systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --no-pager > $D/servicios.txt
systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --state=enabled --no-pager > $D/habilitados.txt
systemctl is-enabled atd crond > $D/atd-crond.txt
habilitar:
systemctl disable sysstat.service
systemctl enable systemd-timesyncd.service
unidad-httpd:
systemctl cat httpd | grep '^Exec' > /home/learner/aso/f32/exec.txt
grep '^WantedBy=' /usr/lib/systemd/system/httpd.service > /home/learner/aso/f32/wantedby.txt
systemctl enable httpd
httpd-vi:
sed -i 's/^Listen 80$/Listen 8080/' /etc/httpd/conf/httpd.conf echo '

ASO Fundamentos

' > /var/www/html/index.html httpd -t httpd -k start >/dev/null 2>&1
unidad-propia:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/aso-hola.service <<'SOLUCION'
[Unit]
Description=Saludo de ASO

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/logger hola desde ASO

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
SOLUCION
systemctl enable aso-hola
mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/aso-hola.service.d
printf '[Service]\nExecStart=\nExecStart=/usr/bin/touch /tmp/aso-hola\n' > /etc/systemd/system/aso-hola.service.d/override.conf
ordenes-vm:
cat > /home/learner/aso/f32/ordenes.txt <<'SOLUCION'
sudo systemctl start httpd
sudo systemctl stop httpd
sudo systemctl restart httpd
sudo systemctl reload httpd
systemctl status httpd
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl show httpd -p MemoryMax
sudo systemctl set-property httpd CPUQuota=20%
sudo systemd-run -p CPUQuota=10% sha1sum /dev/zero
sudo systemd-cgtop
SOLUCION
